glossary.definition: (1) "Trust with powers created by or available to the former spouse" means a trust that is revocable by the former spouse, with respect to which the former spouse has a power of withdrawal, or with respect to which the former spouse may take a distribution that is not subject to an ascertainable standard but does not mean a trust in which those powers of the former spouse are revoked by section 5815.31 of the Revised Code or similar provisions in the law of another state.
glossary.normalized: trust with powers created by or available to the former spouse
glossary.term: Trust with powers created by or available to the former spouse

glossary.definition: (2) "Ascertainable standard" means a standard that is related to a trust beneficiary's health, maintenance, support, or education.
